value.rationale: This is not a cosmetic basis rewrite: it reverses the source's operational strong-DM conclusion from the classical boundary \(2/3\) to asymptotically perfect fidelity \(1\) using only a calibrated one-qubit phase gate on each shared pair. It also supplies an exact positive performance gap for every nonzero \(J\) and \(D\), clarifying which part of the reported degradation is physical and which is a fixed-measurement-basis artifact.
